profile.headline: Principal Engineer at Western Governors University
profile.summary:
Accomplished iOS Developer with a passion for building efficient mobile applications and a proven track record of delivering robust and user-friendly mobile applications.

 •Programming Languages: Swift| Dart | (Swift UI)| Objective-C – C| Python | Kotlin | .NET | PHP | JavaScript | HTML5 | XML | SQL

 • Software: XCode | Flutter| GitHub | Visual Studio Code | Oracle | Adobe Photoshop | Microsoft Office | Microsoft Teams | MySQL

I recently enjoyed developing and publishing a data management mobile application for a large-scale athletic event. 

Apart from the world of tech, I enjoy reading, traveling with my family and teaching chess to kids at my local schools.

 - Feel free to reach out to me at Stratmon.Jones@gmail.com, I can't wait to meet you!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed and launched a mission-critical iOS/Android diagnostics application used by hundreds of field technicians across 16 luxury-appliance product lines.
• Established staged App Store and Google Play rollouts, CI/CD, release governance, crash monitoring, field-test distribution, and a hotfix pipeline for reliable updates.
• Engineered secure mobile-to-appliance communication using encrypted RS485 serial commands, improving transmission reliability and reducing diagnostic errors.
• Strengthened security by mitigating exposed API keys, implementing private-key authentication, and improving access controls, protecting appliance and diagnostic data.
• Led migration of configuration files to encrypted cloud infrastructure and built automation for firmware updates and Azure diagnostic logging.
• Introduced real-time service analytics to identify failure patterns, improve first-time fix rates, and reduce repeat service calls and warranty costs.
positions.insights: Skills: Flutter · Software Development · Software Deployment · Web Services API · Embedded Systems · Bluetooth Low Energy · Cross-functional Collaborations

positions.title: Senior App Developer (iOS)
positions.description:
Created a dynamic, real-time data management system, complete with GUI, that seamlessly captured the performance data of 323 athletes during a national high-school football combine. (Magic City Showcase)

Spearheaded the end-to-end development of the Magic City Showcase mobile app,  leveraging Swift, Objective-C – C, XCode, Firebase, and Third-Party Libraries (SDWebImage, Firebase Auth, CoreData, CoreLocation); resulted in increased efficiency, 100% improvement in data accessibility, and raised the profile of the event.

Utilized Firebase as the backend database to efficiently store and manage over 139,000 reads and 48,000 writes on athlete data securely and in real time. 

Implemented object-oriented algorithms to generate individualized player cards for each athlete, by assigning their results as properties of their object and having that data read from Firebase.

Optimized the user interface using UIKit and Firebase’s offline data persistence to ensure that coaches, parents, scouts, recruiters, and athletes had immediate access to results even in the case of poor connectivity.

Implemented version control systems, particularly Git and its integrations with XCode, to facilitate a structured codebase throughout the development lifecycle.

Prioritized user privacy and data protection by implementing robust security measures (API Key encryption, tiered credential permissions via Firebase’s backend server code) to safeguard sensitive athlete information in accordance with industry regulations.

Conducted extensive testing and debugging, guaranteeing the accuracy and reliability of the real-time data. 

Maintained and managed the app post-event by responding to user feedback and troubleshooting new features for future iterations of “The Magic City Showcase.”
positions.insights: Skills: Firebase · AWS CloudFormation · Git · Software Development · REST APIs · Swift (Programming Language) · Problem Solving · Mobile Applications · Communication · UIKit · HTML · Mobile Application Development · Mobile Design · Xcode · Python (Programming Language) · Code Review · iOS Design · Computer Science · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM) · Model-View-Controller (MVC)
